signatureEngine.requirement: 装备者的特性与音擎适配特性一致时，音擎效果生效。

refinements.name: 元气一击
refinements.description: 装备者的异常精通提升90点；以太属性的装备者进入前场或发动[特殊技]、[强化特殊技]时获得增益效果：对处于属性异常状态下的敌人造成的伤害提升20%，触发的所有属性异常伤害和[紊乱]伤害提升10%，效果持续15秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间，换回后场时该效果移除。
refinements.descriptionEn: Increases the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency by 90. When the equipper is an Ether character, and comes on-field or uses a Special Attack or EX Special Attack, they gain a buff: DMG dealt to enemies afflicted with Attribute Anomalies increases by 20%, and all Attribute Anomaly DMG and Disorder DMG they trigger increases by 10%, lasting 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration, and the effect is removed when switching off-field.

basic.name: 普通攻击：甜心律动
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的攻击，造成以太伤害；
第四段攻击若命中敌人，在攻击完成后会在场上生成1个[应援能量]。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches up to four consecutive attacks forward, dealing Ether DMG.
After hitting an enemy with the fourth hit, 1 Fandom Power is generated on the field after the attack ends.

special.name: 特殊技：全糖电音
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动踢击，造成以太伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Delivers a forward kick, dealing Ether DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：坠入妄想
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Fall Into Delusion
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按  【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按  【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行强力踢击并追加音波攻击，造成以太伤害，若攻击命中敌人，在攻击完成后会在场上生成3个[应援能量]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Delivers a powerful forward kick followed by a sonic wave attack, dealing Ether DMG. If the attack hits an enemy, 3 Fandom Power are generated on the field after the attack ends.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：滑动变奏
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对目标发动强力斩击，造成以太伤害；
招式发动后，可直接衔接第三段[普通攻击：甜心律动]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash against the target, dealing Ether DMG.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Sweet Melody.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：梦幻联动
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
向前方进行连续攻击，造成大量以太伤害，技能发动时在场上生成4个[应援能量]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launches a series of attacks forward, dealing massive Ether DMG. 4 Fandom Power are generated on the field on skill activation.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：元气百分百
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
释放自身全力，进入[妄想时刻]并对目标发动多段强力射击，造成大量以太伤害；
进入[妄想时刻]时爱芮获得3层[全场应援]效果，同时开启[以太帷幕·妄想重奏]，[以太帷幕·妄想重奏]生效期间，全队角色攻击力额外提升50点，持续30秒，爱芮重复开启[以太帷幕·妄想重奏]前，将关闭已有的[以太帷幕·妄想重奏]；
爱芮在蓄力时，若自身有[全场应援]效果，则优先消耗[全场应援]进行蓄力，每消耗1层[全场应援]可提升2段蓄力等级；
在进入[妄想时刻]时，若自身已有[全场应援]效果，则会先将剩余层数的[全场应援]转化为[应援能量]生成在场上，每层[全场应援]可转化为2个[应援能量]；
[妄想时刻]最大持续15秒，在[妄想时刻]期间，爱芮的第三段[普通攻击：绝对音准]将会提升为强化版；
退出[妄想时刻]时，若自身有[全场应援]效果，也会将剩余层数[全场应援]转化为[应援能量]生成在场上，每层[全场应援]可转化为2个[应援能量]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Releases all her power, entering Moment of Delusion, and fires multiple powerful shots at the target, dealing massive Ether DMG.
Upon entering Moment of Delusion, Aria gains 3 stacks of All-Out Cheering and activates Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise. While Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise is active, all squad members gain an additional 50 ATK for 30s. Re-activating Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise will first cancel any existing instance of Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise.
While Aria is charging, if she has All-Out Cheering, stacks of All-Out Cheering are consumed first to charge. Each stack of All-Out Cheering consumed increases the charge level by 2.
Upon entering Moment of Delusion, if Aria already has All-Out Cheering, all remaining stacks of All-Out Cheering are first converted into Fandom Power and generated on the field. Each stack of All-Out Cheering is converted into 2 Fandom Power.
Moment of Delusion lasts for up to 15s. During Moment of Delusion, Aria's Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch 3rd attack is upgraded to an enhanced version.
When exiting Moment of Delusion, if Aria has All-Out Cheering, all remaining stacks of All-Out Cheering are converted into Fandom Power and generated on the field. Each stack of All-Out Cheering is converted into 2 Fandom Power.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：破碎幻梦
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：

招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Delivers a powerful slash to the target, dealing Ether DMG.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Sweet Melody.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：极限救场
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.descriptionEn:

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text:
爱芮的异常精通提升90点；
爱芮的第三段[普通攻击：绝对音准]重击命中处于以太异常状态、电属性异常状态、火属性异常状态、物理属性异常状态、冰属性异常状态、风属性异常状态的目标时，触发一次[异放]：额外结算一次属性异常伤害，相对于原属性异常伤害的比例为每10点初始异常掌控27.5%/14.3%/35.7%/2.5%/3.6%/1.4%，当目标处于失衡状态下时，该伤害比例额外提升50%。
facts.textEn:
Aria's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 90.
If Aria's 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch lands a heavy attack on an enemy suffering an Ether, Electric, Fire, Physical, Ice, or Wind Anomaly, it will trigger Abloom, which resolves an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG equal to 27.5%/14.3%/35.7%/2.5%/3.6%/1.4% per 10 points of initial Anomaly Mastery of the original Anomaly DMG. If the target is Stunned, the DMG ratio is further increased by 50%.

cinema.name: 元气声浪
cinema.description: 爱芮的[普通攻击]、[特殊技]，[强化特殊技]对敌人造成伤害时，无视目标10%的以太异常积蓄抗性；且自身触发[异放]时有概率触发暴击：基础暴击率为25%，暴击伤害为25%；若初始异常掌控大于100点，每超过1点初始异常掌控会使该效果的暴击率额外提升0.5%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Aria's Basic Attack, Special Attack, or EX Special Attack deals DMG to enemies, it ignores 10% of the target's Ether Anomaly Buildup RES. Additionally, when Aria triggers Abloom, it has a chance to trigger a critical hit. The base CRIT Rate is 25%, and CRIT DMG is 25%. If initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 100, each additional point of initial Anomaly Mastery increases this effect's CRIT Rate by 0.5%.

cinema.name: 梦幻节拍
cinema.description: 爱芮攻击和触发[异放]时无视目标16%防御力；在[妄想时刻]持续时间内，攻击和触发[异放]时额外无视目标8%防御力。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Aria attacks or triggers Abloom, it ignores 16% of the target's DEF. During Moment of Delusion, attacks and Abloom triggers also ignore an additional 8% of the target's DEF.

cinema.name: 梦想家
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 机械天使
cinema.description: 爱芮触发[异放]时，自身获得4点能量和70点喧响值，10秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Aria triggers Abloom, she gains 4 Energy and 70 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 10s.

cinema.name: 雨中之泪
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 构造体之梦
cinema.description: 进入战场时，爱芮立即获得1200点喧响值，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次；且爱芮进入[妄想时刻]后将不会退出，强化版[普通攻击：绝对音准]和[终结技]造成的以太伤害提升40%；当爱芮处于[妄想时刻]时，若场上有敌人进入属性异常状态，爱芮获得1层[全场应援]，该效果6秒内最多触发一次；在获得[全场应援]效果时，若自身已有3层[全场应援]效果，则会将溢出的[全场应援]效果转化为2个[应援能量]生成在场上。
cinema.descriptionEn: Upon entering the battlefield, Aria immediately gains 1,200 Decibels. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s. After Aria enters Moment of Delusion, she will not exit it, and enhanced Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch and her Ultimate deal 40% increased Ether DMG. While in Moment of Delusion, when an enemy on the field enters an Anomaly state, Aria gains 1 stacks of All-Out Cheering. This effect can occur once every 6s. When gaining the All-Out Cheering effect, if already at 3 stacks of All-Out Cheering, any excess All-Out Cheering is converted into 2 Fandom Power and generated on the field.

basic.name: 普通攻击：甜心律动

点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的攻击，造成以太伤害；
第四段攻击若命中敌人，在攻击完成后会在场上生成1个[应援能量]。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches up to four consecutive attacks forward, dealing Ether DMG.
After hitting an enemy with the fourth hit, 1 Fandom Power is generated on the field after the attack ends.

basic.name: 普通攻击：绝对音准
basic.description:
长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
爱芮进入蓄力状态，最多可进行三段蓄力，松开 【普通攻击键】 或达到最大蓄力时间时，爱芮将根据当前蓄力段数，向前方发动强力下落攻击，造成大量以太伤害；
若爱芮在蓄力时，自身附近有[应援能量]，则会吸收[应援能量]，每成功吸收1个[应援能量]可立即提升蓄力等级1段，且获得1层增益效果：下一次[普通攻击：绝对音准]造成的以太异常积蓄值提升10%。该增益效果最多叠加2层，攻击结束后效果移除；
在[普通攻击：甜心律动]第四段、[特殊技：全糖电音·不加冰]、[强化特殊技]、第三段[普通攻击：绝对音准]、[快速支援]、[连携技]、[终结技]后，若附近的[应援能量]大于等于2个，则可通过长按 【普通攻击键】 消耗2个[应援能量]直接快速发动第三段[普通攻击：绝对音准]；在第三段[普通攻击：绝对音准]、[连携技]、[终结技]后，若附近的[应援能量]大于等于2个，也可通过在一段时间内点按 【普通攻击键】 消耗2个[应援能量]直接快速发动第三段[普通攻击：绝对音准]；
蓄力期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%，攻击发动期间拥有无敌效果。
basic.descriptionEn:
Hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Aria enters a charging state and can reach three levels of charge. Releasing [Basic Attack] or reaching the maximum charge time causes Aria to unleash a powerful downward attack forward based on the current charge level, dealing massive Ether DMG.
If there is Fandom Power nearby while Aria is charging, she will absorb the Fandom Power, with each absorbed Fandom Power instantly increasing charge level by 1 and granting 1 stack of a buff that increases the next Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch's Ether Anomaly Buildup by 10%. This buff can stack up to 2 times and is removed after the attack ends.
After the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Sweet Melody, Special Attack: Full-Sugar Electronica - No Ice, an EX Special Attack, a level three charged Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch, a Quick Assist, a Chain Attack, or an Ultimate, if there are at least 2 Fandom Power nearby, hold [Basic Attack] to consume 2 Fandom Power and quickly activate a level three charged Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch. After a level three charged Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch, a Chain Attack, or an Ultimate, if there are at least 2 Fandom Power nearby, a level three charged Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch can also be quickly activated by pressing [Basic Attack] within a short window, consuming 2 Fandom Power.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while charging, and received DMG is reduced by 40%. Character is invulnerable while using this attack.

basic.name: 冲刺攻击：丝滑小连招
basic.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行快速斩击，造成以太伤害；
若在[普通攻击：甜心律动]中发动，此动作期间不会重置普通攻击段数。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Launches a swift slashing attack forward, dealing Ether DMG.
If activated during a Basic Attack: Sweet Melody chain, this action does not reset the Basic Attack count.

ex.name: 特殊技：全糖电音
ex.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动踢击，造成以太伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
ex.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Delivers a forward kick, dealing Ether DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 特殊技：全糖电音·不加冰
ex.nameEn: Special Attack: Full-Sugar Electronica - No Ice
ex.description:
在[普通攻击：甜心律动]第四段、[支援突击]、[连携技]和[终结技]后，点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动更加迅捷的踢击，造成以太伤害，若攻击命中敌人，在攻击完成后会在场上生成1个[应援能量]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
After the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Sweet Melody, an Assist Follow-Up, a Chain Attack, or an Ultimate, press [Special Attack] to activate:
Delivers a quicker forward kick, dealing Ether DMG. If the attack hits an enemy, 1 Fandom Power is generated on the field after the attack ends.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：坠入妄想
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Fall Into Delusion
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按  【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行强力踢击并追加音波攻击，造成以太伤害，若攻击命中敌人，在攻击完成后会在场上生成3个[应援能量]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Delivers a powerful forward kick followed by a sonic wave attack, dealing Ether DMG. If the attack hits an enemy, 3 Fandom Power are generated on the field after the attack ends.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：光速入坑
ex.description:
[强化特殊技：坠入妄想]发动后，能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方追加强力下落攻击，造成以太伤害，若攻击命中敌人，在攻击完成后会在场上生成3个[应援能量]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
After launching EX Special Attack: Fall Into Delusion, and with enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Performs a powerful downward attack in front, dealing Ether DMG. If the attack hits an enemy, 3 Fandom Power are generated on the field after the attack ends.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：元气百分百
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
释放自身全力，进入[妄想时刻]并对目标发动多段强力射击，造成大量以太伤害；
进入[妄想时刻]时爱芮获得3层[全场应援]效果，同时开启[以太帷幕·妄想重奏]，[以太帷幕·妄想重奏]生效期间，全队角色攻击力额外提升50点，持续30秒，爱芮重复开启[以太帷幕·妄想重奏]前，将关闭已有的[以太帷幕·妄想重奏]；
爱芮在蓄力时，若自身有[全场应援]效果，则优先消耗[全场应援]进行蓄力，每消耗1层[全场应援]可提升2段蓄力等级；
在进入[妄想时刻]时，若自身已有[全场应援]效果，则会先将剩余层数的[全场应援]转化为[应援能量]生成在场上，每层[全场应援]可转化为2个[应援能量]；
[妄想时刻]最大持续15秒，在[妄想时刻]期间，爱芮的第三段[普通攻击：绝对音准]将会提升为强化版；
退出[妄想时刻]时，若自身有[全场应援]效果，也会将剩余层数[全场应援]转化为[应援能量]生成在场上，每层[全场应援]可转化为2个[应援能量]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Releases all her power, entering Moment of Delusion, and fires multiple powerful shots at the target, dealing massive Ether DMG.
Upon entering Moment of Delusion, Aria gains 3 stacks of All-Out Cheering and activates Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise. While Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise is active, all squad members gain an additional 50 ATK for 30s. Re-activating Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise will first cancel any existing instance of Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise.
While Aria is charging, if she has All-Out Cheering, stacks of All-Out Cheering are consumed first to charge. Each stack of All-Out Cheering consumed increases the charge level by 2.
Upon entering Moment of Delusion, if Aria already has All-Out Cheering, all remaining stacks of All-Out Cheering are first converted into Fandom Power and generated on the field. Each stack of All-Out Cheering is converted into 2 Fandom Power.
Moment of Delusion lasts for up to 15s. During Moment of Delusion, Aria's Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch 3rd attack is upgraded to an enhanced version.
When exiting Moment of Delusion, if Aria has All-Out Cheering, all remaining stacks of All-Out Cheering are converted into Fandom Power and generated on the field. Each stack of All-Out Cheering is converted into 2 Fandom Power.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：破碎幻梦
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对目标发动强力斩击，造成以太伤害；
招式发动后，可直接衔接第三段[普通攻击：甜心律动]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Delivers a powerful slash to the target, dealing Ether DMG.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Sweet Melody.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

150100001.name: 普通攻击：甜心律动
150100001.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的攻击，造成以太伤害；
第四段攻击若命中敌人，在攻击完成后会在场上生成1个[应援能量]。
150100001.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches up to four consecutive attacks forward, dealing Ether DMG.
After hitting an enemy with the fourth hit, 1 Fandom Power is generated on the field after the attack ends.
